text:
Samir K: Quick weekly: Asteria Corp hosted spend + health snapshot — something's off vs their $25k/mo commit.
Priya G: TL;DR numbers?
Samir K: 7d summary -> tokens: 1,200,342 ; est spend: $28,400 ; over-commit by ~$3.4k. Spike Monday ~03:00 UTC for ~2h.
Samir K: Error rate jumped to 0.6% (baseline ~0.12%). P95 latency climbed to 420ms (normal ~310ms).
Priya G: Link to dashboards?
Samir K: https://internal.redwood/metrics/asteria?range=7d — also raw query we used:
```sql
SELECT day, sum(tokens) as tokens, avg(error_rate) as err, p95(latency_ms) as p95
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id = 'asteria' AND time >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
```
CS-Bot: alert: spend_threshold_exceeded - customer=asteria threshold=1.1M_tokens window=7d
Jordan L: Is this traffic from prod keys or from a dev/service account? any new model rollouts to them?
Michaela R: We did a controlled canary last Wed — rolled v2-quant to a 10% subset for Asteria's route. They stayed on 'redwood/gpt-medium-v2' otherwise.
Jordan L: v2-quant shouldn't increase tokens. Could be prompt/template change or client-side looping retries.
Samir K: I grabbed a sample of requests during the spike — see snippet, note long system prompt added by client last week:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.com
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood/gpt-medium-v2",
  "input": {
    "system_prompt": "<very long policy blob... 8k chars>",
    "messages": [...] 
  }
}
```
Priya G: That long system prompt explains token blowout. Did they change onboarding template? Michaela, did CS enable extended context for them?
Michaela R: Yes — we accidentally enabled the new onboarding guidance payload for their integration flow. I flagged it internally; rolling it back now.
Ops: Created incident INC-2456, assigned to @Jordan L (runtime), @Priya G (billing). Notifying Asteria CSM.
Jordan L: I'll validate whether the long prompt is persisted in caching/batching paths and if it caused retries. Also checking if errors (0.6%) are 429s from burst throttles.
Priya G: For immediate mitigation, suggest: 1) apply a soft daily cap at their commit level, 2) mute high-cost system prompts via the routing rules, 3) issue a provisional credit if needed. Can we set a soft cap quickly?
Ops: Running the quota update now:
```bash
# temp cap to prevent further overage
redwood-cli customers update-quota --id asteria --daily-tokens 1100000
```
CS-Bot: billing_note: provisional_credit_issued amount=$1200 reference=INC-2456
Samir K: Great. Action items: Priya will reconcile spend and propose credit, Jordan will root-cause latency/error bump, Michaela will confirm rollback of onboarding payload. I'll follow up with Asteria at EOD.
Michaela R: Rollback done, pushed change to their integration, monitoring for drop in tokens.
Jordan L: Found client retry loop triggered by 502s from their downstream; fixing routing fallback to avoid duplicate requests.
Priya G: I'll open a billing ticket with proposed $1200 credit and schedule a short call with their finance lead.
Samir K: Thanks team. Recheck in next Tue sync unless we see further anomalies. :thumbsup:
